entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed a little over a month ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number please?
Of course. The name is Alex Miller, order number is VF-789012.

Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up. I see the AeroShield helmet, delivered about 40 days ago. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's purely a preference. The online pictures made the color look like a matte gray, but it's much shinier in person. I haven't even taken it out; the box is still unopened.

I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be tricky. Since you received the helmet 40 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.

That's great to hear, thank you. I appreciate how straightforward that is. Now, I am a VIP member and I spend quite a bit here. Since I have to go through the trouble of shipping this back, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase?

That's a fair question, Alex. I do see you're one of our top customers, and we absolutely want to make things right for you. While I can't generate a percentage-based discount code, I can offer you a $20 VeloFit credit on your account as a thank you for your loyalty. You can use it on your next order.
A $20 credit works. I can use that to get the helmet in the correct color. I do appreciate that you stand by your products and focus on customer safety by allowing returns on unused gear like this.

Of course. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email on file. Once our warehouse scans the returned, unopened box, the refund will be issued, and that $20 credit will be automatically applied to your account. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. You've been very helpful, Charlie.
My pleasure, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
